summary: This study is testing different doses of a drug called Semaglutide compared to an inactive placebo in adults with Alcohol Use Disorder and obesity. Researchers want to see how these treatments affect alcohol cravings, stress hormones, and alcohol use over a 20-week period. Participants will include men and women between the ages of 18 and 68 who meet specific health and drinking criteria. The trial is identified by NCT07772960.
